web_ui.title: CT research report
web_ui.description: Review experimental wording, selected anatomy, source volume digest and model revision.

setup_guide.introduction: I can walk you through the format of an experimental CT report before you share a scan. To run a research review, upload a de-identified .nii or .nii.gz file with + and choose chest or abdomen. The report is for research use only.

real.introduction: Upload a de-identified CT volume and choose the anatomy present. The final required answer starts a research run; I'll explain the saved experimental report and its limitations in Chat.

fields.label: CT file
fields.description: Upload a de-identified 3D .nii or .nii.gz CT with Hounsfield units (64 MiB compressed, 256 MiB expanded maximum). Not for real diagnosis.

fields.label: Anatomy region
fields.description: Choose the region present in the uploaded CT.

fields.label: Saved instructions
fields.description: Manage explanation preferences in Chat > Memory. Scan inputs and research questions use setup controls.

run_guidance.on_start: I’ll prepare the selected scan and anatomy for the research model so its report can be reviewed in context.
run_guidance.report_ready: Expand the research report and check its wording and limits alongside the selected anatomy.
run_guidance.output_ready: Open report.md to review the experimental wording and its limits alongside the selected anatomy.
run_guidance.web_ui_ready: Open the CT research report to check the selected anatomy, model revision and input volume behind the wording.

starter_questions: What CT file and anatomy choice do you need?
Can you walk me through the report format before I upload?
Explain this saved report’s wording and coverage limits.
